methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page using WebFetch on 2026-06-14. For Short.io, the page rendered JS-placeholder prices on the second fetch; prices ($5, $18, $48, $148) were taken from the first successful fetch of the same URL. Rebrandly displayed two price sets on the same page; the lower set ($11/$8, $32/$22, $99/$69) matches the primary column and was used. Dub.co has pivoted to a partner/affiliate platform; no free or starter self-serve tier exists as of this date — confirmed on the official pricing page. T2M pricing confirmed from t2mio.com/pricing/. Annual discount percentages are derived from published annual totals where both rates are shown. Non-telephony vertical: minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null on every plan.
